address: 131 Bloor St. W., Toronto, M5S 1R1, Canada
bio: Looking for a bite to eat in between shopping and sightseeing? Amal, with a sexy, sleek, mod Middle Eastern look and ambient vibe, is just the place. Tables are always in demand here, but the smartly dressed service team handles it all seamlessly. Weekends are especially buzzy thanks to entertainment ranging from belly dancers to DJs spinning tunes. Expect modern presentations of classic Lebanese and Middle Eastern dishes on this halal menu, all prepared with authenticity, heart and refinement. Order a few mezze to start - perhaps the seared halloumi or the spinach fatayer. Then, opt for one of their delicious skewers or grilled octopus, which are worthy choices. For dessert, save room for the delightful kanafeh....
